name: sourcedrecall
description: Local memory for Claude Code. Stores the facts you state about yourself, with your exact words and dates, and gives Claude a short summary at the start of each session. No language model is used to write the memory; everything stays on your machine.

owner.title: Your name
owner.description: The person this memory is about. Facts are written about this name.

briefing.title: Summary at session start
briefing.description: Give Claude a short summary of what it knows about you at the start of each session. Turn off to use memory only when you or Claude ask for it.
